types.name: ChannelRequestContext
types.description: Platform-owned identity for one synchronous adapter invocation. The host binds it before invoking an adapter and clears it in finally. Never populate it from JSON business fields. Plain ThreadLocal deliberately does not propagate identity to asynchronous tasks.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Host or isolated-test lifecycle only. Replaces current thread context; performs no nested restoration or input validation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Host or isolated-test lifecycle only. Removes the current thread context; invoke in finally. Does not restore an earlier binding.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Adapter read access to the current thread context; throws IllegalStateException when no context is bound.

methods.name: getChannelCode

runtimeSemantics.adapterUsage: Read only via current(); no production bind/clear and no identity from business JSON.
runtimeSemantics.threadScope: Plain ThreadLocal; not propagated to asynchronous threads.
runtimeSemantics.lifecycle: Invocation owner binds before adapter execution and clears in finally; no nested restoration.
runtimeSemantics.routing: Does not carry shadow state or replace platform sandbox/route selection.
runtimeSemantics.securityBoundary: Public lifecycle methods are a host/adapter convention, not a tamper-proof in-process access-control boundary.

Standard notification and URL callback operation types used by the platform to select fixed iPay path templates.

types.name: ChannelFacade

types.name: HttpResponse
types.description:
Platform HTTP interaction result. Non-2xx bodies are retained for adapter parsing of channel error codes.
Transport and transaction results are separate: HTTP 200 does not mean payment succeeded, and connection failure does not prove the channel did not accept the transaction.

fields.description: Duration in milliseconds returned by this HTTP execution. The platform outbound summary separately records total retry duration.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Check only whether statusCode is 2xx; neither the success field nor business result codes are read.

enumValues.name: AES

enumValues.description: RSA encryption with an IBCM RSA2 key registration; select padding explicitly.

enumValues.description: OpenPGP; uses the IBCM byte-oriented encryptPlus/decryptPlus methods.

enumValues.name: CMS_DESded
enumValues.description: CMS envelope with Triple DES; encryption requires an institution X.509 certificate.

enumValues.name: CMS_BASE64_DESded
enumValues.description: CMS envelope; unlike CMS_DESded, encryption content must already be Base64 encoded.

enumValues.name: SM2
enumValues.description: IBCM SM2 format; decryption returns Base64-encoded plaintext.

enumValues.name: SM2_CBMC
enumValues.description: CBMC SM2/SM4 envelope; requires an institution certificate with SubjectKeyIdentifier and a KMI private key.

enumValues.description: CITICSH SM2; Base64 input/output. Outbound C1C3C2 differs from inbound ASN.1/hex framing.

enumValues.name: SM4
enumValues.description: IBCM SM4 format; encryption takes Base64 content and uses IBCM's text-key interpretation.

enumValues.name: SM4_BOCSZ
enumValues.description: BOCSZ SM4 format; encryption takes text and uses decoded key bytes.

types.name: BaseChannelRequest
types.description:
Base class for channel-facing SPI requests, carrying platform-populated identity, original payload and outbound address.
The shared platform facade populates request information before invoking an SPI; the concrete channel facade looks up routes and fills domain/path.
Adapters map business fields and must not derive trusted channel identity or an outbound domain from inbound bodies or headers.
iPay notification requests use BaseIpayRequest instead.

types.name: BaseIpayRequest
types.description:
Base class for iPay gateway requests.

Adapters map channel notifications into concrete subclasses. The platform selects the iPay path by notification type and module identity, so these requests do not carry channelCode/path. The gateway client overwrites domain with platform configuration before invocation.

fields.name: requestHeaders

types.name: NotificationService
types.description:
Notification adapter interface. Implementations must provide notifyPayment and override other notifications according to integration scope.
Convert original channel asynchronous notifications into standard iPay notification requests.
All methods use notify + business type names. Their return value is a converted request, not a channel ACK.
Adapters handle notification signature verification, decryption, validation and field mapping; the platform performs subsequent HTTP forwarding.
An SPI definition does not expose a platform entry point: integration also requires the corresponding iPay API and channel capability registration.

types.name: PaymentService
types.description:
Channel payment adapter interface covering payment, post-authentication authorization, cancellation, capture and payment inquiry.
Implementations must provide pay. Other methods are overridden according to integration scope and otherwise throw unsupported-operation exceptions.
Implementations must match capability registration in the channel module; overriding a method does not expose that capability automatically.
SPIs define Java contracts, not HTTP addresses. Platform ingress is defined by Controllers and channel egress by platform routing configuration.

methods.name: pay
methods.description:
Process payment/authorization in the one-call 3DS flow, or the initial 3DS authentication stage in the two-call flow.
Map standard fields to the channel payload and convert the channel response into a standard payment result.

methods.name: authenticateAuthorize
methods.description: Complete payment authorization after authentication in the two-call 3DS flow; separate from the initial pay operation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancel/void a payment before settlement.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Capture an authorized payment.

methods.name: inquiryPayment
methods.description: Inquire about the status of a payment/authorization.

types.name: SecurityCipherMode

enumValues.name: CBC
enumValues.description: Cipher block chaining; requires an IV.

enumValues.name: ECB
enumValues.description: No IV; leaks repeated blocks in symmetric encryption. Use only if the protocol requires it.

enumValues.name: GCM
enumValues.description: Authenticated encryption; requires a unique nonce and authentication tag size.

enumValues.name: CTR
enumValues.description: Counter mode; requires a unique counter/nonce.

types.name: SecurityCipherPadding

enumValues.name: PKCS7Padding
enumValues.description: Symmetric block padding requiring an appropriate installed crypto implementation.

enumValues.name: PKCS1Padding
enumValues.description: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5; use only when the institution protocol requires it.

enumValues.name: NoPadding
enumValues.description: No padding; required for GCM, CTR and CFB.

enumValues.name: ISO10126Padding
enumValues.description: Legacy symmetric padding; support depends on the runtime.

enumValues.name: SSL3Padding
enumValues.description: Legacy padding retained to match the IBCM catalog; support depends on the runtime.

enumValues.name: OAEPPadding
enumValues.description: RSA OAEP with runtime defaults; prefer one of the explicit digest variants.

enumValues.name: OAEPWithSHA_256AndMGF1Padding
enumValues.description: IBCM RSA OAEP: SHA-256 with MGF1-SHA256 and an empty label.

enumValues.name: OAEPWithSHA_1AndMGF1Padding
enumValues.description: IBCM RSA OAEP: SHA-1 with MGF1-SHA1 and an empty label.

types.name: SecurityCipherParameters

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Required for AES, DES, DESede, RSA2, SM4 and SM4_BOCSZ; RSA2 requires ECB.

fields.name: padding
fields.description: Required for block ciphers and RSA2; GCM, CTR and CFB require NoPadding.

fields.name: ivBase64
fields.description:
Required for CBC, CFB, CTR and GCM. Base64 of the institution-protocol IV/nonce.
Generate a fresh IV for encryption; never reuse a GCM/CTR nonce with the same key.
IBCM does not prepend it to ciphertext; carry it in the institution-defined message field.

fields.name: tagBitLength
fields.description: Required for GCM only: authentication tag size in bits (96, 104, 112, 120 or 128).

fields.name: aad
fields.description: Optional GCM authenticated text. Must be identical when decrypting; not encrypted.

fields.name: convert2C1C3C2
fields.description:
SM2_CITICSH decryption only. Null/true uses IBCM's ASN.1-to-C1C3C2 conversion;
false expects IBCM's hex representation instead. Not used when encrypting.

fields.name: pgp
fields.description: PGP only; required for PGP encryption/decryption, absent for all other algorithms.

types.name: SecurityPgpCipherAlgorithm
SecurityPgpHashAlgorithm
SecurityPgpParameters

fields.name: encryptAlgorithm
fields.description: Required for PGP encryption; leave absent for decryption, whose packet carries this value.

fields.name: signAndVerify
fields.description: When true, encrypt also signs and decrypt also verifies. Does not select sign-only operations.

fields.name: signHashAlgorithm
fields.description: Required only when encrypting with signAndVerify=true.

fields.name: armor
fields.description: True: armored text output/input; false: Base64 of the binary PGP packet.
